messages:
jax: quick ask 1: can we add a tiny "cost snapshot" to the route editor that shows expected per-invocation delta if route changes?
meera: yes pls. finance keeps emailing for quick numbers. export CSV would help.
owen: backend needs sampled tokens with routing_decision + cache_hit to estimate shared-cache effects. we can sample 0.5% to keep cardinality low.
dalia: UI: show cold vs warmed estimates and a confidence % based on sample coverage. keep the panel compact.
ops-bot: job started: add-telemetry-routing-decision -> infra/dev (ETA 16:45)
jax: also show per-model breakdown with model_sku and quant_profile columns. product wants an example sentence: "Moving 20% QPS to model-b saves ~4% on avg cost, estimated variance +/-6%"
meera: i'll draft microcopy and legal disclaimer. owen, can the preview API be POST /api/v1/preview/routing?
owen: yep. returns token_cost, cache_savings, per_model_rows, sample_coverage.
dalia: plan sounds good. i'll prototype in next sprint and add CSV export.
jax: thanks all, i'll file RFC and tag owners.
